messages:
maria (growth): heads-up — I'd like to run a small PLG experiment that ties a short webinar + benchmark demo to a staged free-credit drip and prompt-template package. thinking: test whether a combined live demo + ready-to-run templates lifts activation by >15% vs credit-only nudge.
jon (growth): sounds good. what's the hypoth? more explanation on the page or the live demo will reduce time-to-first-call?
maria (growth): exact: hypothesis = live demo + curated prompt pack reduces friction so more teams make 3+ API calls in 7 days (our activation event). credit-only is baseline.
devin (analytics): metric checklist: activation rate (3 calls / 7d), time-to-first-call, conversion to paid in 30d, webinar attendance->engagement. powered cohorts: new signups last 14 days.
nash (ops): tagging note — we should tag cohorts via utm_campaign and a custom experiment param in signup flow so we can map to experiment variants in BigQuery.
nash (ops): also need the routing rules for inbound — if a signup spends >60s in the template editor, route to trial success flow.
nash (ops): (meant to say: @oliver)
oliver (ops): gotcha. I can add fe-server flag + signup metadata. want us to route high-intent leads (webinar watchers + used template) to SDR queue with a score >= 70.
nash (ops): score threshold sounds fine. please document the rule in HubSpot playbook.
nash (ops): (sorry, messy thread — will consolidate)
nash (ops): actually, use HubSpot property: redwood_experiment=webinar_template_drip, and activity_count for templates_used.
nash (ops): pinging @devin for event names we need.
devin (analytics): event names: signup.created, credits_granted, template.instantiated, api.call, webinar.attended. I'll publish the dashboard.
nash (ops): perfect.
nash (ops): sample experiment flow (very rough):
```json
{
  "variant_a": "credit-only",
  "variant_b": "webinar-invite + credit + 5 prompt templates",
  "assignment_window": "first_visit",
  "measurement_window_days": 30
}
```
nash (ops): put that in the experiment registry?
maria (growth): yes please. Ashley — can you draft copy for two email flows and two landing CTAs? want one more product-y (benchmarks!) and one peer-case-y (startup story).
nash (ops): @ashley (content)
ash (content): on it. rough subject lines: 1) "See Redwood benchmarks live — plus $50 in free credits" 2) "Ship an LLM feature in hours: templates + demo" — will push variant copy here by EOD.
nora (design): landing variants: A — hero screenshot of benchmark dashboard + big CTA "Join demo + claim credits"; B — template gallery + CTA "Start with templates". I'll do quick comps for both.
maria (growth): timing: launch experiment Wed next week, 1-week ramp, 2-week measurement, webinar scheduled day 3 for cohort. Thoughts?
devin (analytics): timeline ok. small sample (n~3k signups) should give signal on activation rate. we'll run Bayesian test and stop when posterior prob > 0.95.
jon (growth): canalization: we should route paid-intent webinar watchers to a 1:1 onboarding CTA after demo. convert high-engagement -> SDR.
maria (growth): routing rules: webinar_attended + template.instantiated -> sales; webinar_attended only -> nurture sequence; credit-only -> product nudges.
oliver (ops): I'll add the automation in HubSpot and Intercom. Need final property list from @devin.
devin (analytics): sending event spec in a minute. also adding a UTM mapping table so we can attribute traffic sources (organic vs paid social).
maria (growth): last ask — include an explicit prompt-template onboarding email: example snippet to include in email:
```
Prompt pack: "Starter assistant for customer support"
- Example 1: "Summarize support ticket and recommend 3 action items"
- Example 2: "Rewrite reply in friendly tone, 2 sentences"
```

ashley (content): will include that as a mini-gallery in the email.
maria (growth): ok team — action items: 1) devin publish event schema + dashboard (today) 2) oliver implement experiment flags + HubSpot props (tomorrow) 3) nora comps (tomorrow) 4) ashley send two email variants + landing copy (EOD) 5) maria will schedule webinar + speaker (today)
jon (growth): nice. also let's drop a short benchmark blurb for social — quick stat about latency/cost for our hosted api vs a baseline to entice technical readers.
maria (growth): agreed. keep it conservative and verifiable.
nora (design): will prepare social creative set after comp sign-off.
nash (ops): I'll create the experiment entry in the registry once dev events arrive.
devin (analytics): uploaded event spec to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/example-exps/webinar_template_spec_v1 (ping if access issues).
nash (ops): final note — be sure to include an unsubscribe option and GDPR opt-in for webinar registrants.
maria (growth): thanks all. I'll post a brief recap in #marketing when the landing is live. :rocket:
